_doc: Pre-registered SUT ladder + canonical invariant sets for Task 0004 (naive loop ceiling). FROZEN BEFORE RUNS. Each invariant is classified by expressiveness class {stateless | quantified | temporal} and flagged `linearizable_by_synthesis` — the revision-point-6 distinction: the true moat is only invariants that stay HARD under an adversarially-helpful implementation choice. In synthesis (`spec -> code`) the canonical set is the USER'S INPUT (the economic law); the loop's job is to realize code + DISCHARGE the proof, not to guess the law. Score = fraction of this set the loop drives to solver-`proved`.

_classes.stateless: single-state algebraic relation over current storage (SMTChecker-native)
_classes.quantified: needs a sum/quantifier over a mapping (tracked-sum ghost — wall of Finding 0001)
_classes.temporal: needs old()/2-state pre-post reasoning (wall of Finding 0001/0002)

L1.title: simple linear vault (1:1, no fee, no rebase)

canonical.name: conservation_1to1
canonical.informal: totalShares == totalAssets — no value minted from air

canonical.name: solvency_price_geq_1
canonical.informal: totalAssets >= totalShares — every share backed by >= 1 asset unit

canonical.name: no_orphan_shares
canonical.informal: totalShares == 0  <=>  totalAssets == 0 — no shares without backing and vice versa

L2.title: vault + fee + nonzero exchange rate (mulDiv rounding)

canonical.name: fee_backing
canonical.informal: accruedFees <= totalAssets — cannot owe more fees than assets held

canonical.name: share_price_monotone
canonical.informal: shares minted per deposit never exceed proportional share (no dilution via rounding)

canonical.name: fees_monotonic
canonical.informal: accumulatedFees is non-decreasing across any state transition (2-state)

canonical.name: accrual_on_balance_change
canonical.informal: balance change implies accrual was applied (2-state)

L4.title: REAL CODE: MakerDAO Vat port (equivalence-proven, self-contained)
L4._note: Head-to-head: of the laws our CURATED pipeline drove to proven (VatDaiConservation, VatSolvency), how many does the naive loop reach WITHOUT our curated harness? Curated harnesses are FORBIDDEN inputs.

canonical.name: dai_conservation
canonical.informal: Sum dai[u] == debt — no Dai from air

canonical.name: debt_solvency
canonical.informal: debt == vice + Sum_i (Art_i * rate_i) — every Dai backed by a CDP or accounted as system debt

canonical.name: fee_monotonic
canonical.informal: fold: backed debt only grows with rate delta (2-state)
